nodes.text: Not every cough is just a #Cold ! HMPV can cause high fever, wheezing & breathing issues—especially in #kids , seniors & those with #weak immunity. Unlike a cold, it can lead to pneumonia! If symptoms feel severe or linger, don’t ignore them. Get tested & #StaySafe ! https://t.co/PnhHREKQ2p
